observations.test_strategy: Test-first virtual-clock and loopback-fixture coverage for pre-semantic retry, post-semantic replay denial, backoff, deadlines, attempt bounds, and account exclusion.
observations.continuation_boundary: M0.3 proves an initial request can be replayed before semantic output, but a continuation request with previous_response_id is not assumed portable across a replacement connection.
observations.real_account_gate: The user directed development to continue without account-switch testing; no mock result is represented as real cross-account evidence.
observations.http_sse: Replayable request bytes and preflight SSE events are bounded; any failure after semantic output returns unsafe_to_replay without another selection.
observations.websocket: Initial response.create can reconnect only before semantic output; continuation requests remain on the existing connection and never move to another account.
observations.circuit_breaker: Only explicit retryable account failures reach the M2.3 callback; protocol errors and client cancellation do not penalize account health.

residual_risks: Real A-to-B failover before the first semantic event remains deferred until a second authorized account exists.
Codex App Server compatibility E2E and WebSocket control-message behavior remain M3.5.
Production scheduler, credential, circuit-breaker, and proxy-listener composition remains later DAG work.
High-concurrency replay-buffer memory and file-descriptor behavior requires M6 hardening and soak coverage.
Continuation requests are connection-bound; no seamless conversation-continuity claim is permitted.
